extracted.name: Ho Fun Noodles with Beef and Vegetables
extracted.description: Having a good meal with Ho Fun Noodles.
ingredient_lines: 1-1/2 pounds ho fun noodles see my recipe
instruction_lines: Brown the beef and add in the soya sauce, and break up the beef, a bit. Add the vegetables and spices allow to simmer covered till carrots are tender. Add the flour and stir in and cook 4 minutes.
Add in the beef broth except 1 cup. Add the vinegar. Cook till thickened add the noodles, sesame seed oil, and rest of beef broth.
Gently stir and allow to incorporate well. Allow to rest 7 minutes, serve. I hope you enjoy!!!
